falsification_conditions.condition: SPY closes below its 50-day simple moving average for 3 consecutive trading days within the next 14 days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained break below the 50-day SMA would signal loss of intermediate-term momentum and invalidate the HOLD/accumulation bias implied by the 74% pattern match to a bullish March 2024 ETF setup.

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 20 for 5 consecutive trading days within the next 14 days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Persistent elevated volatility above 20 would indicate rising fear and distribution, contradicting the low-blowoff (58) and HOLD signal that assumes controlled, non-panicked conditions.

falsification_conditions.condition: The top 5 holdings of the tracked ETF (e.g., QQQ or SPY) see an average drawdown of more than 7% from their 14-day high within the next 14 days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A broad, sharp drawdown in the largest constituents would show leadership breaking down, invalidating the pattern match to a top formation that requires mega-cap stability to hold.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
